# Repository Structure

```
fluffy-cool-chatbot/
│
├── 📄 chatbot.html              # Main application (single-file app)
├── 📄 training-data.json        # Custom keyword responses
│
├── 📚 Documentation
│   ├── README.md                # Main documentation
│   ├── QUICKSTART.md            # 5-minute setup guide
│   ├── CONTRIBUTING.md          # Contribution guidelines
│   ├── CHANGELOG.md             # Version history
│   ├── SECURITY.md              # Security policy
│   ├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md       # Community standards
│   └── CONTRIBUTORS.md          # Hall of fame
│
├── ⚖️ LICENSE                    # MIT License
├── 🚫 .gitignore                # Git ignore rules
│
└── 📁 .github/                  # GitHub-specific files
    ├── ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
    │   ├── bug_report.md
    │   └── feature_request.md
    └── PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
```

## File Descriptions

### Core Files

- **chatbot.html** - Complete standalone application (~150KB)
  - HTML structure
  - CSS styling (dual themes)
  - JavaScript logic (~2,500 lines)
  - No external dependencies

- **training-data.json** - Custom response database
  - 40+ keywords
  - 400+ custom responses
  - Dual personality responses
  - Easy to edit (no coding required)

### Documentation

- **README.md** - Comprehensive guide
  - Features overview
  - Installation instructions
  - Usage examples
  - Customization guide
  - FAQ

- **CONTRIBUTING.md** - For contributors
  - How to contribute
  - Code style guide
  - Pull request process
  - Development setup

- **CHANGELOG.md** - Version history
  - What's new
  - Bug fixes
  - Breaking changes
  - Roadmap

- **SECURITY.md** - Security policy
  - Vulnerability reporting
  - Security best practices
  - Supported versions

---

**Total Size:** ~200KB uncompressed  
**Dependencies:** 0  
**Frameworks:** 0  
**API Costs:** $0

